application_review: Original coarse pivot divisor cap has been replaced by actual tailBound throughout master CRT, divisor sampling, mean-one, copied moments and ordered elimination.
The common tail budget covers every actual tail and lies below after-tail prime gaps, replica shift gaps and the harmonic root; no contradictory before-pivot cap is retained in those interfaces.
Concrete root-only harmonic and square-root auxiliary boxes exactly identify the original finite coefficient law at every stage.
Insertion rapid error and translated elimination combine to the original fixed-dimension cube row-product limit.
Actual quotient lengths use NATURAL integer division R/(J|M_q|). Their lower length and displacement bounds are derived from sparse polynomial size and actual prime support.
Each polynomial uses only slots at its own replica gap; independent replicas may use different gaps.
W-divisibility of actual smooth factors is derived from coefficient absorption W^(e0+1)c|M, not inferred from smoothness alone.
Original prime events are not renormalized, and support restriction changes no finite average, including zero-mass events.
No desired moment, prefactor, terminal limit, insertion error or cube limit is supplied as a hypothesis.
Common fixed dimension and original concrete test/prime-slot/parameter identifications remain to be connected to the full dual test system. StrongConjecture remains unproved.

The preprint normalizes the surviving good prime tuples (04_correlation.tex, lines 387-388). The present theorem proves the numerator under the unnormalized event law. Exact normalized replica expansion and good-event probability tending to one still need connection; no normalized full dual-test theorem is claimed.
